purpose: Point-bound fixed linear operators for the exact query fractions needed by a job, without resampling a source kink at the query through a global grid interpolation.
native_grid: For each distinct interior query x, use a single retained HOPPET negative-order grid with xmin=x, ymax=-log(x) and a declared fixed interval count. The query is its exact canonical boundary. Every upstream argument x'>=x is sampled from strict initial inputs.
row_projection: Apply the independently checked constrained native adjoint to a unit cotangent at each query/time, exporting each row directly with linear native workspace. Do not construct a nodes-by-scales-by-scales cotangent tensor. Store rows and the map into the sorted union of exact initial nodes; compare row multiplication against the full native forward map before releasing the context.
numerical_loop: Julia applies detached fixed Float64 rows. Float64-backed ForwardDiff values, including nested duals, are unpacked into shared primal/tangent batch columns for contiguous Float64 BLAS products and then reconstructed. BigFloat-backed duals retain generic arithmetic as an independent high-precision reference path. Native contexts are closed after construction; h1 and Hhat3 plans coexist without shared Fortran state or callbacks.
endpoint: Queries at one return exactly zero on the constrained h(1)=0 subspace. Other queries must lie strictly between zero and one. Repeated queries preserve their requested order and share preparation.
derivatives: All grid/query/scale/coupling settings are fixed. Julia ForwardDiff differentiates the initial family and exact row products; there is no derivative through native construction. Fitted settings require dU and are rejected.

validation_policy.physical_values: The unchanged 1e-4 value/refinement targets in KPSY-HOPPET-INPUTS-001 apply at all declared scales and fractions.

identity_dimension_stress.scope: ABI/row-storage identity check only; not a physical multi-scale throughput or G2PERF certificate

validation_policy.reference_precision_reason: Keep the failed full-grid Float64 difference as evidence. High-precision end-to-end initial-family and row-product differences avoid cancellation after a Float64 foreign evolution; the fit remains Float64.
validation_policy.dense_reference_policy: Refine only unconverged scale/quantity cases through this fixed budget. Preserve every coarse comparison; require the same 1e-4 target at the final comparison, otherwise FAIL.

limits: The older global-grid physical-input pilot remains failed and is not admitted by this contract
Source knots within the integration interval still need refinement checks; endpoint alignment alone is not a proof of accuracy
Only supplied queries/scales are cached; new kinematics need a new plan
Matching/observable assembly, historical reproduction and production derivative/performance/coverage admission remain open
